name: input
gotchas: matInput must be hosted on a native `<input>`/`<textarea>` inside a `<mat-form-field>` — it's a directive, not a component, so it contributes no markup of its own and relies entirely on the parent form field for layout.
Setting `type="number"` still gives you a string in `(input)`/`ngModel` unless you also bind through Reactive Forms with a value transformer — matInput does not coerce numeric input values for you.
Auto-growing behavior for `<textarea matInput>` needs the separate `cdkTextareaAutosize` directive from `@angular/cdk/text-field` — matInput alone does not resize the textarea.
